title: 第一卷 风起时 第二十一章 她果然是会飞的第一卷 风起时 第二十二章 先收点利息
content_zh:
;;
当陈风奇察觉到那边已经展开行动后，立刻凝神看向了宝药所在。
随后他就看到有四个人，从四个不同的反向，同时大吼着冲向了宝药。
这四人的速度极快，应该都在凝气五层。
他们口中的吼声未停，人就已经冲到了宝药十丈之内。
可就在这时，有四条触须忽然破土而出，分别击打向四人。
那触须速度更快，眨眼而至，让四人根本没有闪躲的可能，只能以手中灵兵抵挡。
其中有三人，直接被触须巨大的力道轰飞出去。
还有一人因为没能反应过来，抵挡的动作慢了，导致被触须贯穿了身体，鲜血喷洒了一地。
与此同时，一头高足有五丈，双目猩红，腮部长着四条长长触须的怪物，从地下爬了出来。
在它出现的刹那，一股独属于异兽的凶戾气息，瞬间席卷向所有人，仿佛比妖风都来得更加强烈。
哪怕陈风奇相距百余丈远，都还能清晰感受到，忍不住汗毛倒竖。
这绝对是他目前为止，见到过最强的异兽。
那异兽在出现之后，目光直直看向了被触须洞穿之人。
随后，那人竟肉眼可见的开始苍老，生命力与寿元好似具象化了，被触须不断剥夺，最终被异兽吞噬。
这让人胆寒的一幕，也是异兽所独有的，剥夺人寿命的能力。
不过下一刻，随着又一声令下，又有十二道身影出现，再度冲向了异兽。
这十二个人，男女皆有，手中拿着各式各样的灵兵，修为至少也都在凝气五层。
其中还有五人，修为达到了凝气六层。
更有一人，速度最快，赫然达到了凝气七层。

陈风奇目光死死盯着那位凝气七层的修行者，眼中禁不住泛起了死死杀意。
那是一位体型壮硕，满脸横肉的中年男子。
按照图灵的描述，此人应该就是兵冢山的三把手，蚕牙。
同时，陈风奇也察觉到，之前发号施令之人，依然没有出手。
那是一位俊逸青年，正独自站在一个高处，神色淡漠地看着前方即将爆发的大战。
此人，就是祝山。
异兽眼见如此多人忽然冲来，当即怒吼一声，三条触须飞快延伸出去，轻松将三人扫飞。
但它正在吞食寿命的那条触须，却被最先赶来的蚕牙给一刀斩断。
剧痛让异兽发出咆哮，其余三条出手立时转向，宛如化作了三根锋锐长矛，狠狠刺向了蚕牙。
蚕牙咧嘴一笑，大喝一声。
“硬化！”
下一刻，三根触须已经刺在他的身上，却没能刺穿，反而发出宛如钢铁碰撞的“铿锵”声。
但蚕牙也并不好受，触须上出来的恐怖力道，还是让他嘴角溢血。
不过他却强忍着伤势，猛地前冲，将弹出去的三根触须用双手死死钳住，狰狞大喊。
“山主！！”
在他的一声呼唤下，站在高处的祝山，终于准备动了。
可与此同时，一道不知从哪传来的愤怒咆哮声，瞬间笼罩了整片区域。
即便是方才异兽的怒吼，与这道咆哮声相比，也好似成了毫无威胁的老鼠叫声。

When Chen Fengqi realized that an operation had been launched over there, he immediately looked at the location of the treasure.
随后他就看到有四个人，从四个不同的反向，同时大吼着冲向了宝药。
These four people are extremely fast and should all be at the fifth level of Qi Condensation.
Before the roars in their mouths stopped, people had already rushed within ten feet of the treasure medicine.
But at this moment, four tentacles suddenly burst out of the ground and struck four people respectively.
The tentacles were faster and arrived in the blink of an eye, leaving the four of them with no possibility of dodging and could only resist with the spiritual weapons in their hands.
Three of them were directly blown away by the huge force of the tentacles.
Another person failed to react and was too slow to resist, causing the tentacles to pierce his body and blood spraying all over the floor.
At the same time, a monster that was five feet tall, with scarlet eyes and four long tentacles on its cheeks crawled out of the ground.
在它出现的刹那，一股独属于异兽的凶戾气息，瞬间席卷向所有人，仿佛比妖风都来得更加强烈。
哪怕陈风奇相距百余丈远，都还能清晰感受到，忍不住汗毛倒竖。
这绝对是他目前为止，见到过最强的异兽。
After the strange beast appeared, it looked directly at the person who was pierced by the tentacles.
Then, the man began to age visibly to the naked eye, and his vitality and longevity seemed to materialize, being continuously deprived of him by tentacles, and finally devoured by strange beasts.
This frightening scene is also unique to alien beasts, which have the ability to deprive people of their life span.
But the next moment, with another order, twelve more figures appeared and rushed towards the strange beast again.
These twelve people, both male and female, held various spiritual weapons in their hands, and their cultivation levels were at least at the fifth level of Qi Condensation.
Among them, there are five people whose cultivation has reached the sixth level of Qi Condensation.
There was even one person, the fastest, who had reached the seventh level of Qi Condensation.
陈风奇目光死死盯着那位凝气七层的修行者，眼中禁不住泛起了死死杀意。
It was a middle-aged man with a strong build and a sinewy face.
According to Turing's description, this person should be Canya, the third in command of Bingzhong Mountain.
At the same time, Chen Fengqi also noticed that the person who had given orders before still did not take action.
It was a handsome young man, standing alone on a high place, looking indifferently at the battle that was about to break out ahead.
This person is Zhu Shan.
Seeing so many people suddenly rushing towards them, the alien beast roared angrily and quickly extended its three tentacles, easily sweeping the three people away.
But the tentacle that was devouring its life span was cut off by the silkworm fangs that came first.
The severe pain caused the alien beast to roar, and the other three shots immediately turned, as if they turned into three sharp spears, and stabbed the silkworm teeth fiercely.
Canya grinned and shouted loudly.
"Hardening!"
The next moment, three tentacles had pierced his body, but they failed to pierce. Instead, they made a "clang" sound like the collision of steel.
But Canya didn't feel comfortable either. The terrifying force from the tentacles still made his mouth bleed.
However, he endured the injury, rushed forward, clamped the three tentacles that popped out with both hands, and shouted ferociously.
"Mountain Master!!"
At his call, Zhu Shan, who was standing high up, was finally ready to move.
But at the same time, an angry roar came from nowhere and instantly enveloped the entire area.
Even the roar of the strange beast just now seemed like a non-threatening rat's cry compared to this roar.
